params.body:
After #52 the "Vergroten" label showed on cabrio-eyewear.be but a click did nothing. The server serves the new script; the browser did not ask for it. The stylesheets carry a version in their address (`?v=<mtime>`), the script did not, and with no `Cache-Control` on static files a browser keeps a file for a share of its age (heuristic caching on `Last-Modified`), so the old script stayed next to the fresh stylesheet: the lightbox markup arrived, the code that opens it did not. Hoet has no such gap because Vite hashes the script there.

## What changed

- The script tag carries the same version as the stylesheets: `/theme/js/custom.js?v=<mtime>`. Every deploy that touches the file changes the address, and the browser fetches it.
- `ScriptVersieTest` checks the address on a rendered page.

Until this is deployed, a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R, or clearing the site's cache on a phone) gets the new script.

## Verification

Pint, PHPStan and the suite pass. `BuildStampTest` fails in a git worktree only; it passes in CI.
params.title: Version the script address, like the stylesheets
